entries.a42be7083f05ac4d: As the company's basic management policy, it aims to contribute to society while growing itself by actively contributing to the growth of markets, including the information industry, and it states that it will actively incubate businesses to revitalize target markets and encourage new players to take part. It also states that, under a policy of building a business foundation across its target markets to reduce the risk of individual businesses while improving overall growth efficiency, it aims to always maintain an optimal composition of operating companies. Its medium- to long-term management strategy is to actively develop new businesses in addition to growing existing ones, and to expand its business and enhance the overall value of the group by actively using strategic investment in and nurturing of companies, as well as M&A. As the group's priority issues, it lists 4 points: restructuring each operating company, creating new revenue bases, expanding and developing management talent for operating companies, and strengthening the foundation for long-term growth through diversity in the quality of revenue bases.
